item.title: Breaking: Queensland's credit rating downgraded for first time since 2009
item.description: Queensland's credit rating has been downgraded for the first time in almost 20 years, putting pressure on the state's multi-billion-dollar debt and Olympic infrastructure. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Richards

item.title: Company plans 700-metre jetty as part of sand export project
item.description: An upcoming proposal to mine millions of tonnes of sand for export from Tasmania's largest farm triggers concern from Aboriginal groups. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Six Melbourne shops forced shut over illicit tobacco the 'first of many'
item.description: Shops in Footscray and Richmond have been ordered to close for up to 90 days by tobacco licensing inspectors given new powers by the Victorian government. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sydney Roosters claim NRLW minor premiership after another perfect season
item.description: The Roosters come home strong to secure a second straight unbeaten NRLW season as they look to rectify last year's grand final stumble. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Ticehurst’s former partner had pleaded guilty to stabbing her 15 times at her Forbes home just before midnight on 21 April 2024 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Molly Ticehurst’s ex-boyfriend has been sentenced to 28 years in jail for her senseless and brutal murder, which was revenge for her reporting allegations of sexual assault to police. item.title: Man charged after allegedly stealing car with baby inside
item.description: A 51-year-old man is arrested and charged after allegedly carjacking a vehicle with a baby inside in Victoria's north-west. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Mining safety regulator warns against 'unprecedented' vapes in mines
item.description: Resources Safety and Health Queensland is investigating an unprecedented number of reports of contraband being brought into coalmines. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Gamble and Meghan Dansie

item.title: Resort says sale or refinancing will address 'outstanding' superannuation
item.description: The co-owner of a high-profile South Australian island resort confirms the business is working to pay "outstanding” superannuation as Rumi on Louth is listed for sale. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: App owner who lost discrimination case after barring trans woman denied appeal
item.description: The decision shuts down the final avenue of appeal in the landmark case of the Giggle for Girls app and Roxanne Tickle, who was previously awarded $20,000 in damages by the Federal Court. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McKinnell

item.title: Apartment buyer facing $40k shortfall as Bathla collapse puts discount offer at risk
item.description: May bought her apartment on the promise that property developer Bathla would knock $40,000 off the price at settlement. Now with the company in administration, she has no guarantee it will be honoured. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lin Lin

item.title: Man's body found at mine near outback opal town
item.description: The body of a man has been found at an open cut mine south of Coober Pedy in South Australia's outback, police say. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia's northernmost incursion of varroa mite detected in Queensland
item.description: The devastating honey bee parasite Varroa destructor mite has been detected in Far North Queensland, in what is believed to be the most northern detection of the destructive pest in Australia. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sophie Johnson and Selina Green

item.title: Having a toilet at work shouldn't be news, but in the construction industry it is
item.description: There are calls to make toilets and sanitary disposal bins a mandatory part of setting up a construction site in the ACT. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Molly Ticehurst's killer sentenced for 'absolutely terrifying' murder
item.description: The killer of childcare worker Molly Ticehurst has been sentenced to 28 years in jail. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Neil Armfield on Death of a Salesman's relevance to a modern world for sale
item.description: Arthur Miller may have been written his award-winning play in 1948, but its story about a tired, broke and increasingly deluded salesman is as relevant as ever. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Bogie triple murderer appeals against conviction and sentence
item.description: Triple murderer Darryl Valroy Young, 63, lodges an appeal against his conviction and sentence for killing his neighbours at the gate of his cattle station in 2022. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Chomicki

item.title: Blaze destroys 125-year-old Townsville pub
item.description: Townsville's Great Northern Hotel, built in 1900, partially collapses after a fire that took firefighters hours to bring under control. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Chomicki and Emily Anderson

item.title: 'Lawyer X' has compensation claim thrown out of court
item.description: Nicola Gobbo was seeking at least $800,000 in damages from the state of Victoria over claims she was groomed by police to become a source in late 2005. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: BHP subsidiary class action begins over public holiday work
item.description: The class action alleges that a BHP subsidiary did not offer workers a reasonable chance to apply for leave over public holidays. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Liam O'Connell

item.title: Farmer's legacy lives on in wildflower he discovered before tragic death
item.description: Mark Mudie, who was killed while fighting last year's West River bushfire, has been honoured for his discovery of a native wildflower. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chounding and Kate Forrester

item.title: Houthis advance along Yemeni coast, threaten Saudi oil exports in Red Sea
item.description: Iran-aligned Houthis advance along the Yemeni coast as Iranian strikes damage multiple US military aircraft in an escalation on two fronts of the war. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: NSW premier's top staffer in High Court showdown over arrest powers
item.description: James Cullen faced being detained and forced to give evidence before a committee after refusing to attend a parliamentary inquiry over the leaking of confidential minutes. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Alleged arsonist charged over 11 fires across northern Tasmania
item.description: Authorities have been investigating a spate of fires spanning the region from Ulverstone to Perth in northern Tasmania. They have now charged a man in relation to 11 of them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: New pest insect breaches biosecurity and destroys berry crops
item.description: Invasive flower thrips, detected in Australia for the first time, are destroying millions of dollars' worth of berry crops. The pest could spread to vegetables and flowers, and increase food prices. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
